quotes.text: I was just so busy making music
I'm more of a commercial songwriter. If I'm going to write songs I want to make sure people remember the title of it. I was just the type of writing I adapted.

They wanted to put 'Shake Your Booty' in the movie. I told them we're getting ready to release 'Shake Your Booty' as a single so I'd rather you put 'Boogie Shoes' in the movie. So they went with that.

I knew it was coming because when I did my tour in England — 48 cities in 24 days — every place we played in was a type of a club, and they were spinning records. These places were jammed packed. I'd never seen anything like it. There were some places in Miami spinning records, but most places had live music. So I knew after that tour there was something major getting ready to happen and a huge change with bars and how they present music in the clubs. They were going to get away from hiring bands when they could hire one guy to spin records and people would go nuts and love it.
I realized the music we were putting out was a little bit of a threat to rock music. Everybody has their opinions. I don't like everybody's music either. So I'm cool with it.
